global: Long-form explainer (sun-as-laser). Opening: grey question card over a presenter stick figure and an empty whiteboard; series title card; then a chain of diagram scenes on near-black space canvases (ring-shelled sun with nozzles and beam to Earth; beam close-ups; Earth limb with clouds; full Earth disc with a wrapping red glow ring; north-pole Earth diagram with moon reflection rays), two dusk tombstone scenes, a return to the white whiteboard, and a tombstone ending over the crumbling red Earth; red end card with credits.

states.VS006: Dark starfield: glowing sun inside a grey ring shell with two nozzles at left, thin white beam to a small grey Earth at right with a white impact burst; tiny moon upper right. (The red series title card f349-396 precedes this state inside the same rv1 shot; f397 is a hard cut.)
states.VS007: Black canvas: thick white soft-edged beam from the left edge ending mid-canvas; white-ink stick figure right of it with labels and arrows DNA, FATTY ACIDS, BLOOD, MITOSIS, CELLULOSE.
states.VS013: Sun with wide halo left, half-lit grey Earth right; labels '~3.8·10^26 J/second' under the sun and '~1.5·10^22 J/day' under Earth; top note in white caps: MAX SPECIFIED "VISIBLE" LIGHT, WHICH ONLY MAKES UP ~50% OF THE SUN'S ENERGY OUTPUT, BUT A FACTOR OF 1/2 IS NOT GOING TO SAVE US HERE.
states.VS027: Same framing as VS026 (Earth does NOT move; measured): RIP arrow label left, white SAFE with a red scribble over the '?' and red NOT above it, arrow to Earth's far limb.
states.VS028: VS027 plus three tiny white outline tombstones stacked on Earth's right limb under the NOT SAFE arrow.
states.VS039: Glowing red-pink arc ring around dark Earth with a small gap at right (Earth position unchanged from VS038; measured shift 0.003 px); grey outward arrows; tiny stick figure inside the ring at upper right.
states.VS064: Large grey tombstone (opacity fully in by f3756, no scale change) with a ghosted grey Earth disc behind the engraved RIP and the text WE SHOULDN'T HAVE TURNED THE SUN INTO A LASER, on a dark ground line under a starfield.
states.VS065: Red end card: original-transfer must replace with an original series card; layout = mascot silhouette left, GET THE BOOKS call-out with four book covers centre, credits column right, copyright line bottom.

motion: Opening: 6-f cross-fades (background greys down while SUN, rays and UN-SUN-SPECTING EARTH fade in; looped field lines and beam fade in while the label cross-fades to UNINHABITABLE). Everything else is 1-frame pops/swaps (labels, objects, red strike scribbles, red NOT), 1-frame write-on steps of the glow ring (red ring: 5 steps f2102-f2456 at 84/84/195/25/25 f spacing; white ring: 4 steps 6 f apart f3234-f3252), a hold-internal sub-threshold tint fade of the outward arrows red->grey (f2283-f2288, inside VS036), a 6-f fade-out of ~25 wavy arrows (f2912-2917), and a 6-f opacity fade-in of the ending tombstone with no scale change (f3750-3755). Series title card f349-396 animates only the mascot (head/jaw loop) while the type is static. 15 hard cuts plus one in-activity hard cut at f397. Camera static throughout (hold-to-hold shift <= 1.03 px).
continuity: The ring-shelled sun with twin nozzles and the grey Earth keep their design from whiteboard (line art) to space diagrams (shaded); labels upgrade in place (UN-SUN-SPECTING -> UNINHABITABLE; SAFE? -> red NOT SAFE with scribbled '?'; J/day struck in red with ~2,000,000,000x); tombstones recur (TWILIGHT, MOONLIGHT, then broken; tiny tombstones on the limb; final RIP stone); the tiny stick figure on Earth persists until the ring wraps it. Use original mascot/title/end-card art, never the source series card, mascot, logo or credits.
